'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Cooleo DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cooleo]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy|VB8-D-contractkillers-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Cooleo
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
